content:
Apple TV is the exclusive streaming home of Peanuts, and the streamer just announced that four new Peanuts premieres are coming this summer.

Apple TV has two new and two classic Peanuts titles joining its catalog this summer

Snoopy has long been a tentpole of Apple TV’s kids and family-centric programming. And this summer, Apple has announced several additions to its Peanuts lineup.

Camp Snoopy season 2 is coming Friday, June 26, two years after the first season debuted.

This Is America, Charlie Brown premieres one week later, on Friday, July 3. It’s a 1988 miniseries that will newly be made available to stream on Apple TV.

The Charlie Brown and Snoopy Show arrives on Friday, July 10. 18 episodes will be available in total, all originally created from 1983-1986.

Finally, Snoopy Presents: There’s No Place Like Home, Snoopy will premiere on Friday, July 31. Like Camp Snoopy, it’s a brand new Apple production. Per Apple’s plot summary:

Snoopy is devastated when his beloved doghouse is accidentally sold at a yard sale. In an effort to cheer up his pal, Charlie Brown leads Snoopy on an adventure to find his old doghouse, and along the way, they learn what makes a house truly a home.

These join the wide array of new and classic Peanuts titles currently available on Apple TV.

If you’re interested in more of Apple’s family-friendly programming, its latest premiere, My Brother the Minotaur, has garnered strong acclaim.

Apple TV is available for $12.99 per month, or you can get it discounted through the Apple One bundle.
